title: Low-Balance Notices and Auto-Replenishment of TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours Blocks
content:
**Low-balance notice.** When a draw leaves a TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours block's balance at or below the size's low-balance percentage of its block hours, a low-balance notice is emailed to the authorized contact.

**Auto-replenishment.** If that block's auto-replenish setting is on and the size allows auto-replenish, the same draw also books one new block of the same size for the client, priced under the TimeBank block price rule on the day of the draw, with no new order form. A block triggers auto-replenishment at most the size's maximum number of auto-replenishment orders.

**Setting.** Auto-replenish is turned on or off only by the authorized contact's signed request.

| Balance after the draw | Auto-replenish on | Result |
|---|---|---|
| above the low-balance point | either | no notice, no new block |
| at or below the low-balance point | off | notice emailed |
| at or below the low-balance point | on, block has not yet triggered its maximum | notice emailed and one new same-size block booked |

Hypothetical boundary cases on a 40-hour block with a 20 percent point (8.00 hours): a draw leaving 8.00 hours reaches the point; one leaving 8.01 hours does not.
